verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes its own task pages in plain, second-person language for founder tasks. The EIN online application page explains limits and session behavior conversationally. The Pub 525 update tells filers in plain words how to make an 83(b) election, though it still points to Form 15620 and a service center. The evidence does not show these pages are structured step-by-step walkthroughs, and nothing independent confirms a non-lawyer can follow them end to end. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step task walkthroughs, plain-language coverage beyond fragments of the EIN and 83(b) pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of readability.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
